in_sanskrit.name: Nohar
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Mountain of joy
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Nohar एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Noha', meaning 'mountain' and 'ras', meaning 'joy'. This name is associated with the joy and strength of mountains in Hindu mythology.

in_hindi.name: Nohar
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Mountain of joy

in_tamil.name: Nohar
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் Mountain of joy
in_tamil.long_meaning: Nohar ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Noha', meaning 'mountain' and 'ras', meaning 'joy'. This name is associated with the joy and strength of mountains in Hindu mythology.

in_telugu.name: Nohar
in_telugu.meaning: హిందూ పేరు అంటే Mountain of joy
in_telugu.long_meaning: Nohar ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Noha', meaning 'mountain' and 'ras', meaning 'joy'. This name is associated with the joy and strength of mountains in Hindu mythology.

in_marathi.name: Nohar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Mountain of joy
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nohar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Noha', meaning 'mountain' and 'ras', meaning 'joy'. This name is associated with the joy and strength of mountains in Hindu mythology.

in_bengali.name: Nohar
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Mountain of joy
in_bengali.long_meaning: Nohar একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Noha', meaning 'mountain' and 'ras', meaning 'joy'. This name is associated with the joy and strength of mountains in Hindu mythology.
